representation: unchanged A05 EfficientAT MN04, 384 float32, cosine; pitch off

development.family_reuse: A04 development procedural mechanisms only; new fixed performance/layout, no held-out assets or human labels
development.candidates: two A04 development variants per family; 8s each, plus first .3s of variant-0 pluck as a short file
development.accompaniment: fixed .012 RMS 83Hz sine plus seeded .003 RMS Gaussian noise; saved target and background checked independently
development.truth: half-open native insertion intervals; full 2.4s attack/release or explicitly selected .3s attack; family/source consistency is not instrument identification
metrics: absent forced retrieval without presence threshold
development.localization: IoU and sum of absolute boundary errors, reported separately from full-event containment; no containment-only localization win

real_pilot.selection: largest native decoded allocation and median by frames*channels among the current 72 ready discovery recordings; tie by entry ID
real_pilot.units: first and last 128-row shard of each source in each candidate production grid; no more than 1024 new pilot windows
real_pilot.reuse: one bounded repeat of these committed units, validation charged, no re-embedding

guided_refusal.purpose: metadata-only refusal of the existing cue-dependent output, no reprocessing

components.controlled: the generated 8s harmonic variant-0 mixture, HPSS broad, harmonic and percussive
components.dependency: B02 broad HPSS ignores its recorded cue argument; retain that cue and all ancestry as provenance/exclusions. Guided mode actually consumes a cue and is rejected as a generic bank.
components.promotion: none; experimental region coverage only, original remains default

admission.eligible: finite supported features, all geometry/known-answer checks pass, alternate-family hit@1 no worse than 2.4s development baseline minus one case, full projected build plus reserved delivery/reuse fits every fixed C01 and starter cap
admission.choose: among eligible candidates, maximize fraction of full 2.4s truth events with a containing window, then alternate hit@1, then hit@3, then minimize projected cold build worker seconds, then encoded seconds, then shorter duration; admit at most one
admission.scope: production durations/hops are combined policies, development uses common .5s hop; no claim of calibrated cross-bank scores or relevance promotion
admission.stop: no eligible bank or any fixed cap/memory refusal: retain valid pilot/partial coverage with explicit reason; no replacement batch, cap reset or result-dependent source change

delivery.reuse: one full admitted-bank verification pass, no re-embedding; no repeated old catalogue audit
delivery.query: full Loulou 218..240s mixed original, 217..241s context; version/master offset/rights/layer/complete notes remain unverified
